text.en: A poet shows a woman as the lamp of her family.

Kudumba Vilakku is a work of Bharathidasan, a poet of the twentieth-century renaissance (மறுமலர்ச்சி இலக்கியம்). Such literature praised nature, aroused Tamil feeling, spread rational thought, spoke of equality, urged freedom and stressed women's education.
The poem presents the household woman as the lamp that gives light to her family, and it values learning and good character.
Terms: குடும்ப விளக்கு (family lamp), மறுமலர்ச்சி (renaissance), பகுத்தறிவு (rationalism) and பாரதிதாசன்.
